answer.reason: Only a few verses report what this Pharaoh did; the rest are prophecies of judgment against him.

clauses.english: had his army come out of Egypt, and the Chaldeans left Jerusalem
clauses.quote: Then Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt

doubts: JER 47:1 does not say which Pharaoh smote Gaza, so it may be a different Pharaoh.
The Ezekiel verses and JER 44:30, JER 46:25 foretell judgment on Pharaoh and are not events, so they are left out.
JER 25:19, JER 43:9 and JER 46:17 only name Pharaoh or his house and add no deed.
